units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:1">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>עִגְבוֹתָיו … מאקרא וכ׳</he> (not <he>עגביותין</he>) the earth for Adam’s rump was taken from Aḳra &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 888:4">Yalk. Ps. 888</cite>.

<cite ref="Niddah 30b:41">Nidd. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>וב׳ עקביו על ב׳ עגבותיו</he> and its (the foetus’) two heels lie against the two sides of its rump; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 547:4">Yalk. ib. 547</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 24a:10">Ber. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ … משום ערוה</he> the contact of posteriors (of two persons lying in one bed) does not come under the class of indecency (as regards prayer).
Sabb. 152ᵃ (expl. החגב, Koh. XII, 5) אלו ע׳ that means the rump; (comment. the genitals; Lev. R. s. 18 לוז של שדרה; Koh. R. to XII, 5 קרסוליו).
